title: Git stage, unstage, commit, and explicit pull-request controls
scope: Candidate files and frozen-baseline replacement manifest only; no live product or user repository was changed.
implemented: Settings Git pane with absolute repository configuration, changed-file selection, complete patch review, explicit stage/unstage, complete staged-diff commit review, and separate PR review/publish controls.

Canonical ordinary-worktree identity checks, fixed-root bounded argv execution with shell:false, Git environment allowlisting, empty hooksPath, disabled fsmonitor/credential helper/external diff settings, and repository filter/transport-helper rejection.
Single-use expiring in-memory review tokens bound to repository, branch, HEAD, raw index bytes, worktree/staged digests, action, paths, patch, and commit/PR fields; restart invalidates tokens.
Private-index patch application and commit-tree/write-tree CAS branch update with app lock plus index.lock; worktree and live index remain unchanged for stage/unstage/commit.
PR publish is explicit, never pushes, rechecks configured HTTPS remote identity, local symbolic branch, local head/base, exact remote head/base OIDs, and invokes noninteractive gh only after review.
Cancellation or timeout reports unknown/no-retry; commit update conflicts disclose commit OID/orphan-object outcome.
unsupportedCases: Linked worktrees, submodules/gitlinks, symlink repository paths, detached HEAD, unborn HEAD, bare/nonordinary repositories, and unsupported index modes 120000/160000.
Untracked/conflicted/rename/copy changes, binary patches, mode changes, filter attributes, unsafe leading-dash or noncanonical paths, and patches over the bounded safety limit.
Non-HTTPS or credentialed remote URLs, local SSH/proxy/helper/URL-rewrite transport configuration, missing remote/upstream/base, ahead/behind/diverged state, or exact remote head/base OID mismatch.
Automatic push, automatic PR creation, hooks, signing, credential-helper execution, and retry after a consumed/rejected/unknown action token.

validation.syntaxCommand: bundled node --check on candidate CJS/JS and transformed frozen-baseline JS/CJS
